owner_rules: Done means ALL evidence: implemented as specified (task id), a test that FAILED before and passes now, suites green, measured number vs target, docs regenerated, committed AND pushed to the contract's branch.
Never defer: no "later", "follow-up", "out of scope". If blocked: what blocks, what you tried, what you need; then continue with the next task.
Root cause, then fix: file:line + mechanism. No weakening tests, raising timeouts, skips, relaxed assertions.
No silent scope cuts: never lower targets, caps or test sizes without owner approval.
Never bypass guards: no --no-verify, no bypass env vars, no skip flags.
Deliver continuously: one task per commit, pushed to the contract's branch as it goes green.
Honest reporting: TASK-ID | status | commit | tests | measured vs target | missing.

tasks.title: ACFA-RS patent and licence check recorded before any release package is designed
requirements: MV-LIC-02: ACFA-RS licence and patent terms are checked separately before the release package is designed. (source: owner notes of 31 Oct 2026, docs/scope-one/programme/REQUIREMENTS.md:88; evidence docs/scope-one/programme/DECOMPOSITION.md:119; baseline 8.5)
tasks.description: Repo: memev-ops. Owner or counsel task: LICENSE is Apache-2.0; patent position unverified. The record has four sections, Licence of ACFA-RS, Patent position, Sources and date and Result, and writes no patent number. The result is one of cleared, not cleared or awaiting counsel; no release package is designed before it reads cleared. ACFA-RS is described only as an external integration behind the provider boundary.

criteria.statement: The record has its four sections

verifier.cmd: for n in "Licence of ACFA-RS" "Patent position" "Sources and date" "Result"; do grep -qi "^## $n" contracts/ACFA-LICENCE-CHECK.md || exit 1; done

criteria.statement: The licence section states the licence as Apache-2.0
The patent section says "not verified" or "verified by counsel on" a date

verifier.pattern: ^## Patent position(?:(?!^## )[\s\S])*(not verified|verified by counsel on 20\d\d-\d\d-\d\d)

criteria.statement: The sources section gives the date the licence and patent files were read
The result is exactly one of cleared, not cleared or awaiting counsel
The result section ties the release package to a cleared result
The record writes no patent number
Committed and pushed on its own branch for review; nothing is pushed to main

stop_rules: No weakening of an existing test, no raised timeout, no skip, no widened scope; if blocked, report what blocks and continue with the next independent task.
A criterion that cannot be checked from this repository is reported as unchecked, never marked as passing.
